sources.ambient_dry_bulb: FortyGuard /v1/heatmap, one call per hour, this site's own tile
sources.wind_and_dewpoint: NWS api.weather.gov gridpoint forecast (free, keyless). FortyGuard's API carries no wind field, and env_params returns no dry-bulb -- findings section 9.4
sources.rise: this site's own 576-solve rise table on its real OSM geometry

nws.uom_note: windSpeed converted km/h -> m/s; dewpoint already C

fortyguard_env.matched_against_note: the replayed heatmap's own window date, so the temperature and the humidity describe the same day when a response for it exists

alignment.method: cross-correlate FortyGuard wet-bulb against NWS dew point over the horizon
alignment.note: too few overlapping hours to measure the lag; FortyGuard's array is used as labelled and the DST caveat stands unresolved

spend.note: cache hits are byte-identical to fresh calls -- N-55

margin_provenance.source: cycle.bound_day_level -- the quantile of FortyGuard's OWN measured forecast-vs-outcome day-level residuals
margin_provenance.not_used: rolling.py's per-lead margins are calibrated on de-biased PERSISTENCE error, which describes a different forecaster. Using them here would be the category error PLAN section 8e exists to prevent.
margin_provenance.prereg_verdict: FAIL -- 65.6 % measured against a 90 % promise, worst day 0.0 %
margin_provenance.EXTRAPOLATION_WARNING: Every calibration pair was measured at a ~9.4 h lead against a 14:00 site-local window. This run bounds leads of 1..2 h at whatever hour it is now, so the margin is being applied OUTSIDE its calibration domain. Marginal coverage measured in one (lead, hour-of-day) cell is not a guarantee in another.
margin_provenance.borrowed_note: chicago has no FortyGuard day-pairs of its own, so the margin above was measured at Ashburn and applied here. Its hours and geometry are its own; its BOUND is not.

humidity_source_summary.gate_quantity: wet-bulb where FortyGuard supplied it, dew point where NWS did
humidity_source_summary.note: wet-bulb >= dew point in unsaturated air, so a FortyGuard-gated hour is held to a STRICTER test than an NWS-gated one, never a looser one

air_quality.units_note: the :idx fields carry no documented units or scale (findings 9.3), so a limit is only applied when the caller sets one and is never assumed

commands.reason: upper bound on intake 26.826 C is NOT under the 24.0 C plant limit (recirculation contributes +0.000 C).
